mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a custom home construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom home construction varies significantly based on factors like design complexity, material choices, site conditions, and permitting processes. Generally, a custom home project from initial design to move-in can take anywhere from 12 to 24 months. This includes several phases: design and architectural planning (3-6 months), permitting and approvals (1-3 months), and the actual construction phase (8-14 months). Unexpected delays due to weather, material availability, or inspections can also impact the overall schedule. A clear project schedule will be provided after the design phase is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom home construction typically takes 12 to 24 months, including design, permitting, and construction. This can vary based on project complexity and other factors.
